enableStatblockImporter.name: Statblock Importer
enableStatblockImporter.hint: Adds an Import Statblock button to the Actors sidebar (GM only). Paste a vault bestiary markdown file to preview its stats against the GM Core creature-building benchmarks and create the NPC.

statblockImporter.pasteHint: Paste the full markdown file (frontmatter included). Prose after the frontmatter becomes the NPC's public notes.
statblockImporter.noFrontmatter: No YAML frontmatter found (expected a --- … --- block at the top).
statblockImporter.notAStatblock: The frontmatter has no `statblock: true` marker.
